item.title: Featured Artwork: Melinda Whitmore
item.description: Melinda Whitmore: Melinda depicts the fullness of ordinary human life—its triumphs and trials—with honesty and candor. She is drawn to the vulnerability and psychology of the figure as much as to its physical form. Through paint and clay, she captures everyday gestures, love, and quiet humanity, moving beyond portraiture to reveal mood and spirit. Her […]

item.title: Jason Bard Yarmosky: Time Has Many Faces
item.description: Jason Bard Yarmosky’s work centers on themes of aging, time, and memory. He mixes traditional 17th- and 18th-century painting techniques with contemporary imagery, incorporating dreamlike elements, theatrical costume, and staged interiors that heighten a sense of intimacy.

item.title: Wende Caporale-Greene: The Art of Feeding Community
item.description: Through richly detailed paintings, Wende Caporale-Greene honors the farmers, fishers, cheesemongers, and other food purveyers whose work sustains local communities.
